description: This file implements a logging forwarding mechanism for GStreamer logs, including a custom log function that formats log messages and a function to enable log forwarding within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

methods.name: gstreamerLogFunction
methods.description: A custom GStreamer log function that formats log messages and outputs them via Rialto logging.

methods.name: enableGstLogForwarding
methods.description: Enables forwarding of GStreamer logs by replacing the default log function with the custom implementation.
